name: Effect: Aura of Corruption
descr: The creature is treated as if it was a plant for the purposes of any effect that particularly harms or inconveniences plant creatures more than other creatures, but does not gain any benefits of being a plant creature.

name: Effect: Aura of Disquietude
descr: A creature [frightened](/condition/frightened-player-core) by the aura can't flank.

name: Effect: Aura of Misfortune
descr: Living creatures must roll twice on all d20 rolls and use the lower result.

name: Effect: Battle Cry
descr: The creature gains a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls.

name: Effect: Blasphemous Utterances
descr:
The creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saves against mental effects.

It can't take actions that have the [concentrate](/trait/concentrate) trait unless it succeeds at a Flat DC 10 check. Failing this check wastes the action.

name: Effect: Blood Soak
descr: The creature gains a +4 status bonus to damage rolls.

name: Effect: Bogwid Fever
descr: You are enfeebled, and the DC to recover from persistent bleed damage increases based on the stage of disease.

name: Effect: Brand of the Impenitent
descr: The creature takes a -1 status penalty to AC and saves, reduces its resistances by 2, and gains weakness 2 to holy.

name: Effect: Calming Bioluminescence
descr: The creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects.

name: Effect: Caustic Mucus
descr: The creature takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speed. This Speed reduction ends with the persistent acid damage.

name: Effect: Chaotic Spawning
descr: The vescavor swarm becomes Huge and quickened. It can only use the extra action each round for the Ravenous Bites action.

name: Effect: Clinging Suckers
descr: If you are Medium or smaller, you take a –5-foot status penalty to your Speeds.

name: Effect: Conductive Downpour
descr: Creatures in the aura gain weakness 10 to electricity.

name: Effect: Crystalline Dust Form
descr: The creature gains a fly Speed of 40 feet.

name: Effect: Curse of Boiling Blood
descr: You gain weakness to fire 20 and are slowed 1.

name: Effect: Curse of Fire
descr: You gain weakness to fire 15.

name: Effect: Curse of Frost
descr: You gain weakness to cold 15.

name: Effect: Dero Medicine
descr: You gain weakness 2 to slashing.

name: Effect: Devour Soul
descr: The creature gains 10 temporary Hit Points and a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls.

name: Effect: Devour Soul (Victim Level 15 or Higher)
descr: The creature gains 10 temporary Hit Points and a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls.

name: Effect: Distracting Frolic
descr: The target ally can roll the save twice and take the better result.

name: Effect: Elemental Field
descr: You take a –1 status penalty to saves against electricity spells.

name: Effect: Engulf and Swallow Whole
descr:
Granted by Engulf or Swallow Whole

You are grabbed, slowed 1, and you have to hold your breath or start suffocating. You can only attack the origin with unarmed attacks or with weapons of light Bulk or less, and the origin is off-guard against the attack. If the origin takes piercing or slashing damage equaling or exceeding the listed Rupture value from a single attack or spell, you cut yourself free.

name: Effect: Ensnare
descr: The creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed.

name: Effect: Entangling Slime
descr: You are clumsy 1 and take a –5-foot penalty to Speed.

name: Effect: Fan Bolt
descr: The creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to its swim Speed.

name: Effect: Fetid Fumes
descr: Everything within the aura is concealed by smoke.

name: Effect: Filth Wave
descr: You take a penalty to your Speeds.

name: Effect: Frill Defense
descr: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Glutton's Feast
descr: The ogre glutton gains 1d4 temporary hit points, or 2d4 following glutton's rush.

name: Effect: Goblin Song
descr: The creature takes a -1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves.

name: Effect: Graveknight's Curse
descr: The creature's Speed is reduced by 10.

name: Effect: Harmonizing Aura (Allies)
descr: The creature gains a +2 status bonus to sonic damage rolls and a +1 status bonus to AC and all saves against sonic and auditory effects

name: Effect: Harmonizing Aura (Enemies)
descr: The creature gains a -2 status bonus to sonic damage rolls and a -1 status bonus to AC and all saves against sonic and auditory effects

name: Effect: Hunted Fear
descr: The creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to Survival checks to avoid getting lost.

name: Effect: Hydra Heads
descr: The number of heads the hydra currently has.

name: Effect: Infectious Aura
descr: You take a –2 status penalty to saves against disease.

name: Effect: Inspiring Display
descr: That target gains 4 temporary Hit Points that last until the start of the cavern mage's next turn.

name: Effect: Inspiring Presence (Empyreal Dragon)
descr: Creatures within the aura gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws and skill checks.

name: Effect: Interpose
descr: The creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Invigorating Passion
descr: The creature gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and 10 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Invoke Rune
descr: A glowing copy of the invoked rune appears on a single weapon the giant holds, granting the weapon one effect of the giant's choice.

name: Effect: Light of Truth
descr: Against creatures affected by this light, the zoaem and their allies gain a +1 status bonus to damage rolls and Recall Knowledge checks.

name: Effect: Living Shield
descr: The rekhep grants an adjacent ally a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until they're no longer adjacent or until the start of the archon's next turn, whichever comes first.

name: Effect: Lost Red Cap
descr: The creature takes a -4 status penalty to its damage rolls.

name: Effect: Mangling Rend
descr: The target takes a –20-foot status penalty to all Speeds until the end of its next turn.

name: Effect: Miasma
descr: Any creature in the miasma is concealed and treats other creatures as concealed.

name: Effect: Moon Frenzy
descr: The creature becomes one size larger, increases its reach by 5 feet, and increases the damage of its jaws Strike (or a similar Strike) by 2.

name: Effect: Pain Frenzy
descr: The creature gains a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls.

name: Effect: Phytohydra Heads
descr: The number of heads the hydra currently has.

name: Effect: Profane Gift
descr: The creature gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, skill checks, and saving throws.

name: Effect: Protean Anatomy
descr: The creature gains resistance to either acid, electricity, or sonic according to its Protean Anatomy.

name: Effect: Ravenous Young
descr: Once a larva is attached, the target becomes [Drained 1](/condition/drained-player-core). While the larva remains attached, the target cannot recover from persistent bleed.

name: Effect: Revert Form
descr: The creature gains a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and skill checks.

name: Effect: Sinful Bite
descr: You take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds.

name: Effect: Slime Trap
descr: The creature takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds.

name: Effect: Soul Lock (Healing)
descr: The cacodaemon gains fast healing 5 for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Soul Siphon
descr: The creature gains 5 temporary Hit Points and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls.

name: Effect: Splintered Ground
descr: The creature takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

name: Effect: Splintered Ground (Critical Failure)
descr: The creature takes a –15-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

name: Effect: Sticky Spores
descr: The creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to all its Speeds.

name: Effect: Swarming Bites
descr: You become clumsy 1. If you attempt a concentrate or manipulate action while affected, you must succeed at a Flat DC 5 or the action is lost; roll the check after spending the action, but before any effects are applied.

name: Effect: Sylvan Wine
descr: The creature gains a +1 item bonus to Will saves and a +3 item bonus to Will saves against fear effects.

name: Effect: Tail Lash
descr: You take a –2 circumstance penalty to the triggering roll.

name: Effect: Take Them Down!
descr: The creature gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

name: Effect: Tooth Tug
descr: You take a –1 status penalty to Charisma-based skill checks and must succeed at a DC 5 flat check to Cast a Spell unless that spell has the [subtle](/trait/subtle) trait.

name: Effect: Transfer Protection
descr: A creature can wear a willing cassisian as a helmet. While it does, the cassisian can't act, but the cassisian extends their +1 status bonus to AC and saves against unholy creatures to their wearer. At any time, the cassisian can detach themself from their wearer as a single action.

name: Effect: Undead Mastery
descr: The creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, AC, saves, and skill checks.

name: Effect: Unluck Aura
descr: The creature must roll twice and take the worse result on all checks.

name: Effect: Unsettled Aura
descr: Gosregs project a field of discordant energy that unsettles the minds of thinking creatures. Any non-mindless creature within 30 feet of a gosreg takes a -1 status penalty to Will saves.

name: Effect: Void Shroud
descr: Living creatures in the emanation take a -2 status penalty to saves against fear and death effects.

name: Spell Effect: Courageous Anthem (Kanya)
descr:
Granted by a Kanya's [Courageous Anthem](/spell/courageous-anthem-player-core)

You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear effects.
